content:
The side lengths are proportional to
\[
\frac14,\quad \frac1{12},\quad \frac1h.
\]
Triangle inequalities require
\[
\frac14<\frac1{12}+\frac1h \implies h<6,
\]
and
\[
\frac1h<\frac14+\frac1{12}=\frac13 \implies h>3.
\]
Thus
\[
3<h<6.
\]
The integer possibilities are \(h=4,5\). Since the triangle is scalene, the altitudes must be distinct, so \(h\neq 4\). Therefore \(h=5\).

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
